name: The Ledger
description: Act 2, chapter `the-proof` (STORY.md §16): the `the-ledger` mission on Vess. A smooth ice sheet cut by fractures. North of the Core the ice is drilled: a pit 30 u deep holds the Ledger (`ledger-vault`; reading it sets `ledger-read` and plays `cine-ledger`), with a drill pad on its south lip (`shaft-head`). West, the Choir's first loop: a worn ring path where a dead Engram walked (`choir-loop-old`), with relic grid `origin-run` (five sentinels on the ring and a node at its centre) and grid `shaft` (three sentinels, a node and a cache) round the pit, standing in for the Choir's origin run that guards the shaft in loops. No life, no packs (open spawn, 25 min grace). Still needs: the origin run as moving machines on a patrol loop (an Engram/Choir unit type; the sentinels are static stand-ins), the drilling as a timed objective, and the expedition package.
